Messages.Author: Patrick Drapeau
Messages.Body:
I am struggling to make an efficient Folowers of Set-only deck. I wonder
if i should let down the politic aspect of the presence discipline...

If you could help in this matter or send some of your Setite deck info, it
would be very appreciated.

Thanx

Patrick Drapeau
Quebec

Messages.Author: Scott Whittaker
Messages.Body:
I definitely believe that to make an effective and viable Setite deck,
you need more than one offensive strategy, and this means that politics
should play a large role. To do so, you should always include presence
modifiers such as Bewitching Orations & Business Pressures, as well as a
healthy dose of Bribes and Cryptic Riders: try tempting people with an
attractive Disputed Territory or Consanguinous Boon, then automatically
pass (with added stealth if necessary) Invitation Accepted/Praxis
Seizure/etc. ... Followers of Set should live up to their crafty
reputation in Jyhad both with their nasty clan cards and a healthy dose
of politics.
